compiled_state.title: As a plugin maintainer, every consumer of merge-to-main-pr.sh's guard is enumerated and verified compatible with the non-draft-only amendment
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Enumerate every caller of merge-to-main-pr.sh (sprint Phase 7, fix-bug merge step, debug-everything cleanup, release pipeline, manual operator invocation). For each, verify behavior under S6's amended guard or update the caller. Add one regression test per consumer path.
**Why**: S6 amends a guard used across multiple workflows; a silent break of release pipelines or fix-bug merges is a high-impact regression that scope-limited verification can miss.

**Scope**:
- IN: Enumerate all callers of merge-to-main-pr.sh via grep/codebase scan
- IN: Per-consumer verification: test the amended guard's behavior on each caller's expected PR state
- IN: Per-consumer regression test capturing the verified behavior
- OUT: Modifying merge-to-main-pr.sh's guard logic itself — owned by S6

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, a caller-enumeration document (or comment block in merge-to-main-pr.sh) lists every caller of the guard with its expected PR state and the post-amendment behavior
  ← Satisfies: "SC5 consumer impact verification"
- When this story is complete, a regression test exists for each enumerated caller, asserting the amended guard produces the expected behavior
  ← Satisfies: "SC5 consumer impact verification"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
